数据展示

树形控件 AsamTree

展示层级节点，并让用户展开、选择或勾选本地数据。

使用场景 ​

展示层级节点，并让用户展开、选择或勾选本地数据。

基础用法与状态 ​

下列示例只使用本入口的实际公开能力。

基础用法与状态

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		v-bind="{ data, nodeKey: 'id', showCheckbox: true, defaultExpandedKeys: ['root'] }"
		@node-click="selected = $event.label"
	>
		<template #default="{ data: item }">
			<span>{{ item.label }}</span>
		</template>
	</AsamTree>
	<p role="status">当前节点：{{ selected }}</p>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTreeBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const data = [
	{
		id: 'root',
		label: '本地记录',
		children: [
			{ id: 'draft', label: '草稿' },
			{ id: 'locked', label: '锁定记录', disabled: true }
		]
	}
];
const selected = ref('');
</script>
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		v-bind="{ data, nodeKey: 'id', showCheckbox: true, defaultExpandedKeys: ['root'] }"
		@node-click="selected = $event.label"
	>
		<template #default="{ data: item }">
			<span>{{ item.label }}</span>
		</template>
	</AsamTree>
	<p role="status">当前节点：{{ selected }}</p>
</template>

<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTreeBasicDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const data = [
	{
		id: 'root',
		label: '本地记录',
		children: [
			{ id: 'draft', label: '草稿' },
			{ id: 'locked', label: '锁定记录', disabled: true }
		]
	}
];
const selected = ref('');
</script>

使用约定 ​

data 与 props 映射实际 label/children/disabled 等字段；使用勾选和实例节点操作时提供稳定的 nodeKey。showCheckbox、checkStrictly、defaultExpandedKeys/defaultCheckedKeys、lazy/load、draggable、过滤及节点事件按真实契约使用。default 作用域插槽提供 node/data，empty 插槽处理空数据；实例提供选择、过滤与节点更新方法。它与虚拟 TreeV2 的 API 不应互换，远程加载由宿主 load 实现。

原生协议完整用法与 API ​

以下用法对应固定 2.14.7。Cascader 与 TreeSelect 的示例显式使用 value-mode="native"；其原生值、路径、字段映射和回调不能直接套到标准化模式。API 表保留原生默认值，ASAM 覆盖值与四档尺寸以下列约定为准。

Display a set of data with hierarchies.

Selectable ​

Used for node selection.

This example also shows how to load node data asynchronously.

Selectable

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:props="props"
		:load="loadNode"
		lazy
		show-checkbox
		@check-change="handleCheckChange"
	/>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
/*
MIT License

Copyright (c) 2020-PRESENT Element
Plus

Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
copies or substantial portions of the Software.

THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/selectable.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	name: string;
}

let count = 1;
const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones'
};

const handleCheckChange = (data: Tree, checked: boolean, indeterminate: boolean) => {
	console.log(data, checked, indeterminate);
};

const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'Root1' }, { name: 'Root2' }]);
	}
	if (node.level > 3) return resolve([]);

	let hasChild = false;
	if (node.data.name === 'region1') {
		hasChild = true;
	} else if (node.data.name === 'region2') {
		hasChild = false;
	} else {
		hasChild = Math.random() > 0.5;
	}

	setTimeout(() => {
		let data: Tree[];
		if (hasChild) {
			data = [
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				},
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				}
			];
		} else {
			data = [];
		}

		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};
</script>
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:props="props"
		:load="loadNode"
		lazy
		show-checkbox
		@check-change="handleCheckChange"
	/>
</template>

let count = 1;
const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones'
};
const handleCheckChange = (data, checked, indeterminate) => {
	console.log(data, checked, indeterminate);
};
const loadNode = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'Root1' }, { name: 'Root2' }]);
	}
	if (node.level > 3) return resolve([]);
	let hasChild = false;
	if (node.data.name === 'region1') {
		hasChild = true;
	} else if (node.data.name === 'region2') {
		hasChild = false;
	} else {
		hasChild = Math.random() > 0.5;
	}
	setTimeout(() => {
		let data;
		if (hasChild) {
			data = [
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				},
				{
					name: `zone${count++}`
				}
			];
		} else {
			data = [];
		}
		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};

使用提示

When using show-checkbox, since check-on-click-leaf is true by default, last tree children's can be checked by clicking their nodes.

Custom leaf node in lazy mode ​

A node's data is not fetched until it is clicked, so the Tree cannot predict whether a node is a leaf node. That's why a drop-down button is added to each node, and if it is a leaf node, the drop-down button will disappear when clicked. That being said, you can also tell the Tree in advance whether the node is a leaf node, avoiding the render of the drop-down button before a leaf node.

Custom leaf node in lazy mode

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree style="max-width: 600px" :props="props" :load="loadNode" lazy show-checkbox />
</template>

import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/custom-leaf.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	name: string;
	leaf?: boolean;
}

const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones',
	isLeaf: 'leaf'
};

const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'region' }]);
	}
	if (node.level > 1) return resolve([]);

	setTimeout(() => {
		const data: Tree[] = [
			{
				name: 'leaf',
				leaf: true
			},
			{
				name: 'zone'
			}
		];

		resolve(data);
	}, 500);
};
</script>

Lazy loading multiple times ​

When lazily loading node data remotely, lazy loading may sometimes fail. In this case, you can call reject to keep the node status as is and allow remote loading to continue.

Lazy loading multiple times

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree style="max-width: 600px" :props="props" :load="loadNode" lazy />
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
/*
MIT License

Copyright (c) 2020-PRESENT Element
Plus

Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy
of this software and associated documentation files (the "Software"), to deal
in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights
to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell
copies of the Software, and to permit persons to whom the Software is
furnished to do so, subject to the following conditions:

The above copyright notice and this permission notice shall be included in all
copies or substantial portions of the Software.

THE SOFTWARE IS PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
IMPLIED, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE WARRANTIES OF MERCHANTABILITY,
FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE AND NONINFRINGEMENT. IN NO EVENT SHALL THE
AUTHORS OR COPYRIGHT HOLDERS BE LIABLE FOR ANY CLAIM, DAMAGES OR OTHER
LIABILITY, WHETHER IN AN ACTION OF CONTRACT, TORT OR OTHERWISE, ARISING FROM,
OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
SOFTWARE.

*/
import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/multiple-times-load.vue

import type { AsamTreeLoadFunction } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = {
	label: 'name',
	children: 'zones',
	isLeaf: 'leaf'
};

let time = 0;
const loadNode: AsamTreeLoadFunction = (node, resolve, reject) => {
	if (node.level === 0) {
		return resolve([{ name: 'region' }]);
	}
	time++;
	if (node.level >= 1) {
		setTimeout(() => {
			if (time > 3) {
				return resolve([
					{ name: 'zone1', leaf: true },
					{ name: 'zone2', leaf: true },
					{ name: 'zone3', leaf: true }
				]);
			} else {
				return reject();
			}
		}, 3000);
	}
};
</script>

	<AsamTree style="max-width: 600px" :props="props" :load="loadNode" lazy />
</template>

Default expanded and default checked ​

Tree nodes can be initially expanded or checked

Use default-expanded-keys and default-checked-keys to set initially expanded and initially checked nodes respectively. Note that for them to work, node-key is required. Its value is the name of a key in the data object, and the value of that key should be unique across the whole tree.

Default expanded and default checked

Checking tree nodes ​

This example shows how to get and set checked nodes. They both can be done in two approaches: node and key. If you are taking the key approach, node-key is required.

Checking tree nodes

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		ref="treeRef"
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:data="data"
		show-checkbox
		default-expand-all
		node-key="id"
		highlight-current
		:props="defaultProps"
	/>

	<div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1 mt-2">
		<AsamButton class="!ml-0" @click="getCheckedNodes">get by node</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton class="!ml-0" @click="getCheckedKeys">get by key</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton class="!ml-0" @click="setCheckedNodes">set by node</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton class="!ml-0" @click="setCheckedKeys">set by key</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton class="!ml-0" @click="resetChecked">reset</AsamButton>
	</div>
</template>

import { AsamTree, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/checking-tree.vue

import { ref } from 'vue';

import type { AsamTreeRenderContentContext, AsamTreeInstance } from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Tree[];
}
type Node = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'];

const treeRef = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();

const getCheckedNodes = () => {
	console.log(treeRef.value!.getCheckedNodes(false, false));
};
const getCheckedKeys = () => {
	console.log(treeRef.value!.getCheckedKeys(false));
};
const setCheckedNodes = () => {
	treeRef.value!.setCheckedNodes(
		[
			{
				id: 5,
				label: 'Level two 2-1'
			},
			{
				id: 9,
				label: 'Level three 1-1-1'
			}
		] as Node[],
		false
	);
};
const setCheckedKeys = () => {
	treeRef.value!.setCheckedKeys([3], false);
};
const resetChecked = () => {
	treeRef.value!.setCheckedKeys([], false);
};

const defaultProps = {
	children: 'children',
	label: 'label'
};

const data: Tree[] = [
	{
		id: 1,
		label: 'Level one 1',
		children: [
			{
				id: 4,
				label: 'Level two 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						id: 9,
						label: 'Level three 1-1-1'
					},
					{
						id: 10,
						label: 'Level three 1-1-2'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},
	{
		id: 2,
		label: 'Level one 2',
		children: [
			{
				id: 5,
				label: 'Level two 2-1'
			},
			{
				id: 6,
				label: 'Level two 2-2'
			}
		]
	},
	{
		id: 3,
		label: 'Level one 3',
		children: [
			{
				id: 7,
				label: 'Level two 3-1'
			},
			{
				id: 8,
				label: 'Level two 3-2'
			}
		]
	}
];
</script>

Custom node content ​

The content of tree nodes can be customized, so you can add icons or buttons as you will

There are two ways to customize template for tree nodes: render-content and scoped slot. Use render-content to assign a render function that returns the content of tree nodes. See Vue's documentation for a detailed introduction of render functions. If you prefer scoped slot, you'll have access to node and data in the scope, standing for the AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] object and node data of the current node respectively. Note that the render-content demo can't run in JSFiddle because it doesn't support JSX syntax. In a real project, render-content will work if relevant dependencies are correctly configured.

Custom node content

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="custom-tree-container">
		<p>Using render-content</p>
		<AsamTree
			ref="treeRef1"
			style="max-width: 600px"
			:data="dataSource"
			show-checkbox
			node-key="id"
			default-expand-all
			:expand-on-click-node="false"
			:render-content="renderContent"
		/>
		<p>Using scoped slot</p>
		<AsamTree
			ref="treeRef2"
			style="max-width: 600px"
			:data="dataSource"
			show-checkbox
			node-key="id"
			default-expand-all
			:expand-on-click-node="false"
		>
			<template #default="{ node, data }">
				<div class="custom-tree-node">
					<span>{{ node.label }}</span>
					<div>

import { AsamTree, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { ref } from 'vue';

	AsamTreeRenderContentContext,
	AsamTreeRenderContentFunction,
	AsamTreeInstance
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Tree[];
}
type Node = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'];
type Data = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['data'];

let id = 1000;
const treeRef1 = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();
const treeRef2 = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();

const append = (data: Data) => {
	const newChild = { id: id++, label: 'testtest', children: [] };
	treeRef1.value?.append(newChild, data);
	treeRef2.value?.append(newChild, data);
};

const remove = (node: Node, data: Data) => {
	treeRef1.value?.remove(data);
	treeRef2.value?.remove(data);
};

const renderContent: AsamTreeRenderContentFunction = (h, { node, data }) => {
	return h(
		'div',
		{
			class: 'custom-tree-node'
		},
		[
			h('span', null, node.label),
			h('div', null, [
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'primary',
						link: true,
						onClick: () => append(data)

						default: () => 'Append'

				),
				h(
					AsamButton,
					{
						type: 'danger',
						link: true,
						style: 'margin-left: 4px',
						onClick: () => remove(node, data)
					},
					{
						default: () => 'Delete'
					}
				)
			])
		]
	);
};

]);

Tree node filtering ​

Tree nodes can be filtered

Invoke the filter method of the Tree instance to filter tree nodes. Its parameter is the filtering keyword. Note that for it to work, filter-node-method is required, and its value is the filtering method.

Tree node filtering

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamInput
		:model-value="filterText"
		class="w-60 mb-2"
		placeholder="Filter keyword"
		@update:model-value="updateFilterText"
	/>

	<AsamTree
		ref="treeRef"
		style="max-width: 600px"
		class="filter-tree"
		:data="data"
		:props="defaultProps"
		default-expand-all
		:filter-node-method="filterNode"
	/>
</template>

import { AsamInput, AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/filtering.vue

import { ref, watch } from 'vue';

import type {
	AsamInputEmits,
	AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction,
	AsamTreeInstance
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

interface Tree {
	id: number;
	label: string;
	children?: Tree[];
}

const filterText = ref('');
const treeRef = ref<AsamTreeInstance>();

const updateFilterText = (value: AsamInputEmits['update:modelValue'][0]) => {
	filterText.value = String(value);
};

const defaultProps = {
	children: 'children',
	label: 'label'
};

watch(filterText, (val) => {
	treeRef.value!.filter(val);
});

const filterNode: AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction = (value: string, data) => {
	if (!value) return true;
	return data.label.includes(value);
};

	}
];
</script>

	children: 'children',
	label: 'label'
};
</script>

Draggable ​

You can drag and drop Tree nodes by adding a draggable attribute.

Draggable

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<AsamTree
		style="max-width: 600px"
		:allow-drop="allowDrop"
		:allow-drag="allowDrag"
		:data="data"
		draggable
		default-expand-all
		node-key="id"
		@node-drag-start="handleDragStart"
		@node-drag-enter="handleDragEnter"
		@node-drag-leave="handleDragLeave"
		@node-drag-over="handleDragOver"
		@node-drag-end="handleDragEnd"
		@node-drop="handleDrop"
	/>

import { AsamTree } from '@asam-ui/ui';
// Adapted from the fixed upstream MIT example: tree/draggable.vue

import type {
	AsamTreeAllowDropType,
	AsamTreeNodeDropType,
	AsamTreeRenderContentContext
} from '@asam-ui/ui';

type Node = AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'];

const handleDragStart = (node: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('drag start', node);
};
const handleDragEnter = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag enter:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragLeave = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag leave:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragOver = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, _event: DragEvent) => {
	console.log('tree drag over:', dropNode.label);
};
const handleDragEnd = (
	draggingNode: Node,
	dropNode: Node | null,
	dropType: AsamTreeNodeDropType,
	_event: DragEvent
) => {
	console.log('tree drag end:', dropNode && dropNode.label, dropType);
};
const handleDrop = (
	draggingNode: Node,
	dropNode: Node,
	dropType: Exclude<AsamTreeNodeDropType, 'none'>,
	_event: DragEvent
) => {
	console.log('tree drop:', dropNode.label, dropType);
};
const allowDrop = (draggingNode: Node, dropNode: Node, type: AsamTreeAllowDropType) => {
	if (dropNode.data.label === 'Level two 3-1') {
		return type !== 'inner';
	} else {
		return true;
	}
};
const allowDrag = (draggingNode: Node) => {
	return !draggingNode.data.label.includes('Level three 3-1-1');
};

const data = [
	{
		label: 'Level one 1',
		children: [
			{
				label: 'Level two 1-1',
				children: [
					{
						label: 'Level three 1-1-1'
					}
				]

				children: [

						label: 'Level three 2-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	},

		children: [
			{
				label: 'Level two 3-1',
				children: [
					{
						label: 'Level three 3-1-1'
					}
				]
			},
			{
				label: 'Level two 3-2',
				children: [
					{
						label: 'Level three 3-2-1'
					}
				]
			}
		]
	}
];
</script>

Tree API ​

Attributes ​

Name Description Type Default
data tree data arrayArray<{[key: string]: any}> —
empty-text text displayed when data is void string —
node-key unique identity key name for nodes, its value should be unique across the whole tree string —
props configuration options, see the following table object —
render-after-expand whether to render child nodes only after a parent node is expanded for the first time boolean true
load method for loading subtree data, only works when lazy is true Function(node, resolve, reject) => void —
render-content render function for tree node Function(h, { node, data, store }) => void —
highlight-current whether current node is highlighted boolean false
default-expand-all whether to expand all nodes by default boolean false
expand-on-click-node whether to expand or collapse node when clicking on the node, if false, then expand or collapse node only when clicking on the arrow icon. boolean true
check-on-click-node whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on the node, if false, the node can only be checked or unchecked by clicking on the checkbox. boolean false
check-on-click-leaf whether to check or uncheck node when clicking on leaf node (last children). boolean true
auto-expand-parent whether to expand father node when a child node is expanded boolean true
default-expanded-keys array of keys of initially expanded nodes arrayArray<string | number> —
show-checkbox whether node is selectable boolean false
check-strictly whether checked state of a node not affects its father and child nodes when show-checkbox is true boolean false
default-checked-keys array of keys of initially checked nodes arrayArray<string | number> —
current-node-key key of initially selected node string / number —
filter-node-method this function will be executed on each node when use filter method. if return false, tree node will be hidden. Function(value, data, node) => boolean —
accordion whether only one node among the same level can be expanded at one time boolean false
indent horizontal indentation of nodes in adjacent levels in pixels number 18
icon custom tree node icon component string / Component —
lazy whether to lazy load leaf node, used with load attribute boolean false
draggable whether enable tree nodes drag and drop boolean false
allow-drag this function will be executed before dragging a node. If false is returned, the node can not be dragged Function(node) => boolean —
allow-drop this function will be executed before the dragging node is dropped. If false is returned, the dragging node can not be dropped at the target node. type has three possible values: 'prev' (inserting the dragging node before the target node), 'inner' (inserting the dragging node to the target node) and 'next' (inserting the dragging node after the target node) Function(draggingNode, dropNode, type) => boolean —

props ​

Attribute Description Type Default
label specify which key of node object is used as the node's label string / Function(data, node) => string —
children specify which node object is used as the node's subtree string —
disabled specify which key of node object represents if node's checkbox is disabled string / Function(data, node) => boolean —
isLeaf specify whether the node is a leaf node, only works when lazy load is enabled string / Function(data, node) => boolean —
class custom node class name string / Function(data, node) => string —

Exposes ​

Tree has the following method, which returns the currently selected array of nodes.

Method Description Parameters
filter filter all tree nodes, filtered nodes will be hidden Accept a parameter which will be used as first parameter for filter-node-method
updateKeyChildren set new data to node, only works when node-key is assigned (key, data) Accept two parameters: 1. key of node 2. new data
getCheckedNodes If the node can be selected (show-checkbox is true), it returns the currently selected array of nodes (leafOnly, includeHalfChecked) Accept two boolean type parameters: 1. default value is false. If the parameter is true, it only returns the currently selected array of sub-nodes. 2. default value is false. If the parameter is true, the return value contains halfchecked nodes
setCheckedNodes set certain nodes to be checked, only works when node-key is assigned (nodes, leafOnly) Accept two parameters: 1. an array of node objects to be checked 2. a boolean parameter. If set to true, only the checked status of leaf nodes will be set. The default value is false.
getCheckedKeys If the node can be selected (show-checkbox is true), it returns the currently selected array of node's keys (leafOnly) Accept a boolean type parameter whose default value is false. If the parameter is true, it only returns the currently selected array of sub-nodes.
setCheckedKeys set certain nodes to be checked, only works when node-key is assigned (keys, leafOnly) Accept two parameters: 1. an array of node's keys to be checked 2. a boolean parameter. If set to true, only the checked status of leaf nodes will be set. The default value is false.
setChecked set node to be checked or not, only works when node-key is assigned (key/data, checked, deep) Accept three parameters: 1. node's key or data to be checked 2. a boolean typed parameter indicating checked or not. 3. a boolean typed parameter indicating whether to recursively check/uncheck child nodes (since , this works regardless of the check-strictly setting).
getHalfCheckedNodes If the node can be selected (show-checkbox is true), it returns the currently half selected array of nodes —
getHalfCheckedKeys If the node can be selected (show-checkbox is true), it returns the currently half selected array of node's keys —
getCurrentKey return the highlight node's key (null if no node is highlighted) —
getCurrentNode return the highlight node's data (null if no node is highlighted) —
setCurrentKey set highlighted node by key, only works when node-key is assigned (key, shouldAutoExpandParent=true) 1. the node's key to be highlighted. If null, cancel the currently highlighted node 2. whether to automatically expand parent node
setCurrentNode set highlighted node, only works when node-key is assigned (node, shouldAutoExpandParent=true) 1. the node to be highlighted 2. whether to automatically expand parent node
getNode get node by data or key (data) the node's data or key
remove remove a node, only works when node-key is assigned (data) the node's data or node to be deleted
append append a child node to a given node in the tree (data, parentNode) 1. child node's data to be appended 2. parent node's data, key or node
insertBefore insert a node before a given node in the tree (data, refNode) 1. node's data to be inserted 2. reference node's data, key or node
insertAfter insert a node after a given node in the tree (data, refNode) 1. node's data to be inserted 2. reference node's data, key or node

Events ​

Name Description Parameters
node-click triggers when a node is clicked four parameters: node object corresponding to the node clicked, node property of AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] itself, event object
node-contextmenu triggers when a node is clicked by right button four parameters: event, node object corresponding to the node clicked, node property of AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] itself
check-change triggers when the selected state of the node changes three parameters: node object corresponding to the node whose selected state is changed, whether the node is selected, whether node's subtree has selected nodes
check triggers after clicking the checkbox of a node two parameters: node object corresponding to the node that is checked / unchecked, tree checked status object which has four props: checkedNodes, checkedKeys, halfCheckedNodes, halfCheckedKeys
current-change triggers when current node changes two parameters: node object corresponding to the current node, node property of AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node']
node-expand triggers when current node open three parameters: node object corresponding to the node opened, node property of AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] itself
node-collapse triggers when current node close three parameters: node object corresponding to the node closed, node property of AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'], AsamTreeRenderContentContext['node'] itself
node-drag-start triggers when dragging starts two parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, event.
node-drag-enter triggers when the dragging node enters another node three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the entering node, event.
node-drag-leave triggers when the dragging node leaves a node three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the leaving node, event.
node-drag-over triggers when dragging over a node (like mouseover event) three parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dragging over node, event.
node-drag-end triggers when dragging ends four parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dragging end node (may be undefined), node drop type (before / after / inner), event.
node-drop triggers after the dragging node is dropped four parameters: node object corresponding to the dragging node, node object corresponding to the dropped node, node drop type (before / after / inner), event.

Slots ​

Name Description Type
default custom content for tree nodes object{ node: UnwrapRef<RootTreeType['root']>, data: Tree | TreeOptionProps }
empty custom content when data is empty —

ts
import type { VNodeRef, ComponentPublicInstance, ComponentOptionsBase, ComponentProvideOptions, VNode, RendererNode, RendererElement } from 'vue';
import type { AsamTreeProps, AsamTreeOptionProps, AsamTreeNodeData, AsamTreeRenderContentContext, AsamTreeFakeNode, AsamTreeData, AsamTreeLoadFunction, AsamTreeExpose, AsamTreeSelectNativeValueProps, AsamTreeKey, AsamTreeRenderContentFunction, AsamTreeAllowDragFunction, AsamTreeAllowDropFunction, AsamTreeAllowDropType, AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction, AsamTreeCheckedInfo, AsamTreeNodeDropType } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTreeProps
type PublicContract = {
	readonly "props"?: AsamTreeOptionProps | undefined;
	readonly "data"?: AsamTreeData | undefined;
	readonly "lazy"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "checkStrictly"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "autoExpandParent"?: (AsamTreeProps)["autoExpandParent"];
	readonly "defaultExpandAll"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "checkDescendants"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "checkOnClickNode"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "checkOnClickLeaf"?: (AsamTreeProps)["checkOnClickLeaf"];
	readonly "accordion"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "draggable"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "indent"?: number | undefined;
	readonly "renderAfterExpand"?: (AsamTreeProps)["renderAfterExpand"];
	readonly "showCheckbox"?: boolean | undefined;
	readonly "expandOnClickNode"?: (AsamTreeProps)["expandOnClickNode"];
	readonly "highlightCurrent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"style"?: unknown;
	readonly "emptyText"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "load"?: AsamTreeLoadFunction | undefined;
	readonly "onCurrent-change"?: ((data: any, node: AsamTreeRenderContentContext["node"] | null) => any) | undefined;
	"key"?: PropertyKey | undefined;
	"ref"?: VNodeRef | undefined;
	"ref_for"?: boolean | undefined;
	"ref_key"?: string | undefined;
	"onVnodeBeforeMount"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeBeforeMount"];
	"onVnodeMounted"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeMounted"];
	"onVnodeBeforeUpdate"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeBeforeUpdate"];
	"onVnodeUpdated"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeUpdated"];
	"onVnodeBeforeUnmount"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeBeforeUnmount"];
	"onVnodeUnmounted"?: (AsamTreeProps)["onVnodeUnmounted"];
	"class"?: unknown;
	readonly "icon"?: (AsamTreeProps)["icon"];
	readonly "nodeKey"?: string | undefined;
	readonly "defaultCheckedKeys"?: AsamTreeKey[] | undefined;
	readonly "defaultExpandedKeys"?: AsamTreeKey[] | undefined;
	readonly "currentNodeKey"?: (AsamTreeProps)["currentNodeKey"];
	readonly "renderContent"?: AsamTreeRenderContentFunction | undefined;
	readonly "allowDrag"?: AsamTreeAllowDragFunction | undefined;
	readonly "allowDrop"?: AsamTreeAllowDropFunction | undefined;
	readonly "filterNodeMethod"?: AsamTreeFilterNodeMethodFunction | undefined;
	readonly "onCheck-change"?: ((data: any, checked: boolean, indeterminate: boolean) => any) | undefined;
	readonly "onNode-click"?: ((data: any, node: AsamTreeRenderContentContext["node"], nodeInstance: AsamTreeExpose["$"] | null, evt: MouseEvent) => any) | undefined;
	readonly "onNode-contextmenu"?: ((evt: Event, data: any, node: AsamTreeRenderContentContext["node"], nodeInstance: AsamTreeExpose["$"] | null) => any) | undefined;
	readonly "onNode-collapse"?: ((data: any, node: AsamTreeRenderContentContext["node"], nodeInstance: AsamTreeExpose["$"] | null) => any) | undefined;

下列为声明可读视图；可导入类型以公开类型视图为准。分支条件与父属性一致。

  • $route.matched: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["matched"] — 依赖声明

    Array of {@link RouteLocationMatched} containing only plain components (any lazy-loaded components have been loaded and were replaced inside the `components` object) so it can be directly used to display routes. It cannot contain redirect records either. **This property is non-enumerable**.

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • $route.name: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["name"] — 依赖声明

    Name of the matched record

  • $route.fullPath: string — 依赖声明

    The whole location including the `search` and `hash`. This string is percentage encoded.

  • $route.query: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["query"] — 依赖声明

    Object representation of the `search` property of the current location.

  • $route.hash: string — 依赖声明

    Hash of the current location. If present, starts with a `#`.

  • $route.redirectedFrom: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"] — 依赖声明

    Contains the location we were initially trying to access before ending up on the current location.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.matched: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "matched"> — 依赖声明

      Array of {@link RouteRecord} containing components as they were passed when adding records. It can also contain redirect records. This can't be used directly. **This property is non-enumerable**.

      嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

    • $route.redirectedFrom.fullPath: string — 依赖声明

      The whole location including the `search` and `hash`. This string is percentage encoded.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.query: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "query"> — 依赖声明

      Object representation of the `search` property of the current location.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.hash: string — 依赖声明

      Hash of the current location. If present, starts with a `#`.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.redirectedFrom: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "redirectedFrom"> — 依赖声明

      Contains the location we were initially trying to access before ending up on the current location.

      嵌套展开边界：递归引用；完整类型见公开类型视图。

    • $route.redirectedFrom.name: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "name"> — 依赖声明

      Name of the matched record

    • $route.redirectedFrom.meta: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "meta"> — 依赖声明

      Merged `meta` properties from all the matched route records.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.params: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "params"> — 依赖声明

      Object of decoded params extracted from the `path`.

$routeNormalized current location. See {@link RouteLocationNormalizedLoaded}.（依赖声明）
$route 参数与 payload

下列为声明可读视图；可导入类型以公开类型视图为准。分支条件与父属性一致。

  • $route.matched: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["matched"] — 依赖声明

    Array of {@link RouteLocationMatched} containing only plain components (any lazy-loaded components have been loaded and were replaced inside the `components` object) so it can be directly used to display routes. It cannot contain redirect records either. **This property is non-enumerable**.

    嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

  • $route.name: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["name"] — 依赖声明

    Name of the matched record

  • $route.fullPath: string — 依赖声明

    The whole location including the `search` and `hash`. This string is percentage encoded.

  • $route.query: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["query"] — 依赖声明

    Object representation of the `search` property of the current location.

  • $route.hash: string — 依赖声明

    Hash of the current location. If present, starts with a `#`.

  • $route.redirectedFrom: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"] — 依赖声明

    Contains the location we were initially trying to access before ending up on the current location.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.matched: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "matched"> — 依赖声明

      Array of {@link RouteRecord} containing components as they were passed when adding records. It can also contain redirect records. This can't be used directly. **This property is non-enumerable**.

      嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

    • $route.redirectedFrom.fullPath: string — 依赖声明

      The whole location including the `search` and `hash`. This string is percentage encoded.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.query: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "query"> — 依赖声明

      Object representation of the `search` property of the current location.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.hash: string — 依赖声明

      Hash of the current location. If present, starts with a `#`.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.redirectedFrom: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "redirectedFrom"> — 依赖声明

      Contains the location we were initially trying to access before ending up on the current location.

      嵌套展开边界：递归引用；完整类型见公开类型视图。

    • $route.redirectedFrom.name: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "name"> — 依赖声明

      Name of the matched record

    • $route.redirectedFrom.meta: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "meta"> — 依赖声明

      Merged `meta` properties from all the matched route records.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.params: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "params"> — 依赖声明

      Object of decoded params extracted from the `path`.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.path: string — 依赖声明

      Percentage encoded pathname section of the URL.

    • $route.redirectedFrom.replace: boolean | undefined — 依赖声明

      Replace the entry in the history instead of pushing a new entry

      枚举：false / true

    • $route.redirectedFrom.force: boolean | undefined — 依赖声明

      Triggers the navigation even if the location is the same as the current one. Note this will also add a new entry to the history unless `replace: true` is passed.

      枚举：false / true

    • $route.redirectedFrom.state: PublicMember<NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["redirectedFrom"]>, "state"> — 依赖声明

      State to save using the History API. This cannot contain any reactive values and some primitives like Symbols are forbidden. More info at https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/History/state

  • $route.meta: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["meta"] — 依赖声明

    Merged `meta` properties from all the matched route records.

  • $route.params: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$route"]>)["params"] — 依赖声明

    Object of decoded params extracted from the `path`.

  • $route.path: string — 依赖声明

    Percentage encoded pathname section of the URL.

$router{@link Router} instance used by the application.（依赖声明）
$router 参数与 payload

下列为声明可读视图；可导入类型以公开类型视图为准。分支条件与父属性一致。

  • $router.options: (NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$router"]>)["options"] — 依赖声明

    Original options object passed to create the Router

    • $router.options.routes: (NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$router"]>)["options"]>)["routes"] — 依赖声明

      Initial list of routes that should be added to the router.

      嵌套展开边界：框架 / 平台类型；完整类型见公开类型视图。

    • $router.options.history: (NonNullable<(NonNullable<AsamTreeExpose["$router"]>)["options"]>)["history"] — 依赖声明

      History implementation used by the router. Most web applications should use `createWebHistory` but it requires the server to be properly configured. You can also use a _hash_ based history with `createWebHashHistory` that does not require any configuration on the server but isn't handled at all by search engines and does poorly on SEO.

      • $router.options.history.base: string — 依赖声明

        Base path that is prepended to every url. This allows hosting an SPA at a sub-folder of a domain like `example.com/sub-folder` by having a `base` of `/sub-folder`

        嵌套展开边界：深度上限；完整类型见公开类型视图。

      • $router.options.history.location: string — 依赖声明

import type { AsamTreeData, AsamTreeExpose, AsamTreeComponentProps, AsamTreeSelectExpose, AsamTreeNodeData, AsamTreeProps, AsamTreeFakeNode } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTreeData
type PublicContract = {
	"length": number;
	"toString": () => string;
	"toLocaleString": (AsamTreeData)["toLocaleString"];
	"pop": () => AsamTreeNodeData | undefined;
	"push": (...items: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => number;
	"concat": { (...items: ConcatArray<AsamTreeNodeData>[]): AsamTreeNodeData[]; (...items: (AsamTreeNodeData | ConcatArray<AsamTreeNodeData>)[]): AsamTreeNodeData[]; };
	"join": (separator?: string) => string;
	"reverse": () => AsamTreeNodeData[];
	"shift": () => AsamTreeNodeData | undefined;
	"slice": (start?: number, end?: number) => AsamTreeNodeData[];
	"sort": (compareFn?: ((a: AsamTreeNodeData, b: AsamTreeNodeData) => number) | undefined) => AsamTreeData;
	"splice": { (start: number, deleteCount?: number): AsamTreeNodeData[]; (start: number, deleteCount: number, ...items: AsamTreeNodeData[]): AsamTreeNodeData[]; };
	"unshift": (...items: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => number;
	"indexOf": (searchElement: AsamTreeNodeData, fromIndex?: number) => number;
	"lastIndexOf": (searchElement: AsamTreeNodeData, fromIndex?: number) => number;
	"every": { <S extends AsamTreeNodeData>(predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): this is S[]; (predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): boolean; };
	"some": (predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => boolean;
	"forEach": (callbackfn: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => void, thisArg?: any) => void;
	"map": <U>(callbackfn: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => U, thisArg?: any) => U[];
	"filter": { <S extends AsamTreeNodeData>(predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): S[]; (predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): AsamTreeNodeData[]; };
	"reduce": (AsamTreeData)["reduce"];
	"reduceRight": (AsamTreeData)["reduceRight"];
	"find": { <S extends AsamTreeNodeData>(predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, obj: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => value is S, thisArg?: any): S | undefined; (predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, obj: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any): AsamTreeNodeData | undefined; };
	"findIndex": (predicate: (value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, obj: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => unknown, thisArg?: any) => number;
	"fill": (value: AsamTreeNodeData, start?: number, end?: number) => AsamTreeData;
	"copyWithin": (target: number, start: number, end?: number) => AsamTreeData;
	"entries": () => ArrayIterator<[number, AsamTreeNodeData]>;
	"keys": () => ArrayIterator<number>;
	"values": () => ArrayIterator<AsamTreeNodeData>;
	"includes": (searchElement: AsamTreeNodeData, fromIndex?: number) => boolean;
	"flatMap": <U, This = undefined>(callback: (this: This, value: AsamTreeNodeData, index: number, array: AsamTreeNodeData[]) => U | readonly U[], thisArg?: This | undefined) => U[];
	"flat": <A, D extends number = 1>(this: A, depth?: D | undefined) => FlatArray<A, D>[];
	"at": (index: number) => AsamTreeNodeData | undefined;
	[Symbol.iterator]: () => ArrayIterator<AsamTreeNodeData>;
	readonly [Symbol.unscopables]: { [x: number]: boolean | undefined; length?: boolean | undefined; toString?: boolean | undefined; toLocaleString?: boolean | undefined; pop?: boolean | undefined; push?: boolean | undefined; concat?: boolean | undefined; join?: boolean | undefined; reverse?: boolean | undefined; shift?: boolean | undefined; slice?: boolean | undefined; sort?: boolean | undefined; splice?: boolean | undefined; unshift?: boolean | undefined; indexOf?: boolean | undefined; lastIndexOf?: boolean | undefined; every?: boolean | undefined; some?: boolean | undefined; forEach?: boolean | undefined; map?: boolean | undefined; filter?: boolean | undefined; reduce?: boolean | undefined; reduceRight?: boolean | undefined; find?: boolean | undefined; findIndex?: boolean | undefined; fill?: boolean | undefined; copyWithin?: boolean | undefined; entries?: boolean | undefined; keys?: boolean | undefined; values?: boolean | undefined; includes?: boolean | undefined; flatMap?: boolean | undefined; flat?: boolean | undefined; at?: boolean | undefined; [Symbol.iterator]?: boolean | undefined; readonly [Symbol.unscopables]?: boolean | undefined; };
	[key: number]: AsamTreeNodeData;
};
